message: Amendment batch: Loan Closure (replaces Full Settlement) with independent partial collect/waive on fine and penalty and a plain-language pool-credit breakdown popup shown after every payment; loan numbers now assigned via admin-only Bahi No per account type (E-/B-/O- prefix, one-time-per-type, editable later by admin); Borrower Credit Rating (0-10, EMI + Overdraft only) with month-wise breakdown popup on Loan Details and a summary shown on the borrower profile; fixed a bug where Overdraft interest cycles closed on the 19th instead of the correct 20th; added Sanction Date (separate from Disbursement Date), with the agent's 'Application Form Collected Date' becoming it automatically on admin approval; new 'Loan Details' bordered Excel report (.xls/.xlsx) in the Reports menu; Loan Details screen buttons consolidated (Ledger+Statement merged, Edit ROI/Profit Share replaced by a single 'Edit Loan Details' with retrospective recalculation and a confirmation warning, destructive actions moved to a separated danger zone); Dashboard cleanup (removed Missing Profit Share and Total Late Fine tiles, added an Active Borrowers/Loans count); removed the Due Today & Overdue card from the default Loans view; Borrowers and Loans screens restructured into a gated Village/Type/Borrower selector with a Submit step (results stay hidden until submitted); added a Village filter to the Loans screen; nav tabs restyled so every tab looks clickable, not only the active one; forms now auto-focus the first invalid field on a validation error.
